entities.name: Velis Vel Grotto
entities.description: A subterranean cavern on Lorwyn associated with changelings, its walls encrusted with quartz and etched with runes commemorating changeling forms.

entities.name: Changelings
entities.description: Shapeshifting tribe of Lorwyn drawn each year to Velis Vel Grotto, where most new changelings are created.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane where Velis Vel Grotto lies.

events.summary: Once a year sunlight enters the grotto; changelings gather, revert to natural forms, and most new changelings are created.
events.quote: Changelings are biologically drawn to the Grotto at this time, where they congregate and revert to their natural forms

relations.quote: It is unknown to the plane's other tribes outside of a few merrows .
